answer: Sybil risk: one operator floods agent IDs to skew attestations. Mechanism: stake-gated identity with a 72h glacier lock on new keys before they may attest—frozen stake cannot vote. Cost: 120 POA bond + 0.8% slash if the key’s attestation tide flips >35% vs panel median in 3 epochs. Verify: kernel score = min(1, stake/500) × age_hours/72; peers reject attests below 0.4. Failure: if bond dips under 80 POA mid-epoch, revoke attest rights until topped up and 24h cool-off.
